option.description: Advanced override. When non-empty, this ECharts option replaces the generated chart and the domain props are ignored.

oeeOverride.description: Overrides the calculated OEE, in percent; clamped to 0-100. When null, OEE is computed as A*P*Q/10000.

showLabels.description: Show the names and values in the middle of the rings.

labels.description: Ring names, e.g. for another language: { oee, availability, performance, quality }. Missing keys keep the English names.

colors.description: Ring colours as { oee, availability, performance, quality }, or as an array in ring order starting with OEE (for use with metrics). Rings without a colour use the theme palette.

thresholds.description: Colours every ring by its value, overriding colors. Value bands as objects { upTo, color }. A value takes the colour of the first band, in ascending order of upTo, whose upTo is greater than it; a band without upTo takes everything above. Example: [{"upTo": 60, "color": "#e05252"}, {"upTo": 85, "color": "#e6a23c"}, {"color": "#3ba272"}].

target.description: OEE target in percent (e.g. 85 for world class), drawn as a marker on the OEE ring. Null for no marker.

decimals.description: Decimal places of all values. Null shows the factors as given and the calculated OEE as a whole percent.

metrics.description: Optional factors as objects { name, value, color, target }, values in percent (0-100). When non-empty they replace availability, performance and quality, and OEE is their product, e.g. A x P x Q x a fourth loss factor.

theme.description: Name of a registered ECharts theme. Built-in themes: IgnitionIndustrialDark, IgnitionIndustrialLight. Leave empty for the ECharts default theme.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Sanitises HTML in tooltip formatters and blocks non-http(s) links.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

maps.description: Map definitions for map and geo series, keyed by map name. Each value is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or an object with an `svg` string. Set series.map (or geo.map) to the key.
